expectedBeats.text: Decker, what am I looking at?
A service data-link. It's restoring power to our internal relay systems.
Think of it like a LAN, but wireless for all of us. Our squad channels are coming back.
You're a genius, Decker.
Hey, I'm just telling you what I know from what we have left.
I'm raising your systems' heat levels. You should be able to toggle up to maximum efficiency.
You'll find an extra surprise for those icy units if they give you any trouble.
Get out of there. The ground is moving.

cinema.text: We all trust you, you know? It'll come in time, I'm sure. Anyway, let's get a move on it!

expectedBeats.text: All right. We're home. What did we find?
We were able to access the network at the base, despite cooling levels being below freezing.
Something sent a distress-signal virus from one of our own satellites.
I can't even understand the code either. It's almost like it's alien. I've never seen any language like this. Ever.
You're saying we may be dealing with something outside of our own world?!
Seems so. If we want answers, we're going to have to head to space, where it last came from, and trace the signal back to its source.
There's an airbase about 500 km to the east. Last I heard, there was supposed to be a space shuttle launch, but it never went through.
I also know the Federation was testing prototype attachment suits for domestic aircraft. We may be in luck.
A shuttle launch facility. That gives us a destination.
And a way up. I'll take those odds.
Prototype space attachments? Now that I want to see.
First we get there. Then we test anything.
If that signal came from orbit, we follow it.
Alien trouble. Just when I thought this couldn't get stranger.
As long as we go together.
Then we go. Better than sitting around twiddling our thumbs. Let's go!
There's one more thing I wanted to show you.
That's your Photon Cannon? Decker, this is incredible!
Come here, you genius!
Easy now, I'm not trying to file a restraining order these days!
When can I test it out?
When we find out what caused all of this mayhem. It's still not quite ready yet.
There's something missing, and I just can't for the life of me figure out what. Or, more importantly, why. I'm usually good at this.
We all trust you, you know? It'll come in time, I'm sure. Anyway, let's get a move on it!

cinema.text: One last check. Then we're going up.

expectedBeats.text: We found the Federation's prototype attachment suits at the airbase. The launch systems are still intact.
Good. Those hulls were built to take ordinary aircraft beyond the atmosphere. I've adapted the mounts for our ships.
The airbase's last uplink confirms it. That distress virus was broadcast from our satellite. Look at the last camera feed.
So that's what's been sending the orders.
And its signal is still up there. We have to trace it before it moves again.
Then we follow it to the source.
The Federation kits are ready. I'll stay here and keep our relay open. Bring back answers.
We got Granddad's bomber flying. We can handle this.
Granddad's bomber had air outside it.
One last check. Then we're going up.
